240-2079-5470-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

2595-4694-7272-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2595-4694-7272-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2595-4694-7272-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

4694-6258-6798-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-6258-6798-7306.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat from step 1.

3175-3899-7424.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

3899-4871-5220-5946.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You control at least three creatures with different powers.
3899-4871-5220-5946.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

3585-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2034-3861-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Orzhov Basilica.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Orzhov Basilica from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Repeat.

1987-3075-4823.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3075-4823.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters
1987-3075-4823.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3075-4823.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2097-2557-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

140-7433-7688.description:
Activate M.O.D.O.K. by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

5256-5508--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the persist creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

5058-5231-7422.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

372-3277-7339.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3277-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Izzet Chronarch and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Izzet Chronarch trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Izzet Chronarch and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2034-4559-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2034-4559-4802-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

4742-6575-6685.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7233.easyPrerequisites: Instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard have total mana value 2 or greater.
2438-6972-7233.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Inferno Project.
When Inferno Project dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

628-2034-7199.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Slumbering Walker.
When Slumbering Walker dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

1409-2557-5418.description:
Activate Exhibition Magician by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Exhibition Magician enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Exhibition Magician.
Resolve the Exhibition Magician trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-1669-4677.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1669-4677.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-2034-2741-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2034-2741-3490.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

14-141-2511.description:
Cast Reincarnation by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Reincarnation, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Reincarnation.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Reincarnation triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 5.

2275-3532-5078-6747.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3678-6879-6906.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3678-6879-6906.description:
Play Treva's Ruins.
When Treva's Ruins enters, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Treva's Ruins.
Resolve the Treva's Ruins trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it
Haru triggers, returning Treva's Ruins from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

229-1940-5220.description:
Cast Endless One by paying {0}.
Endless One enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Liliana, Dreadhorde General.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Endless One from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Endless One from your library.
Repeat.

2173-5220-5231-6539.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Willow Geist.
When Willow Geist dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Willow Geist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Willow Geist from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

2577-5670-6719.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-6719.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1563-1879-2457-3000.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1228-5470-6797.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Goblin Sharpshooter is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
1228-5470-6797.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat from step 2.

628-5256-6672.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrifiicing Bloodied Ghost.
When Bloodied Ghost dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. When it enters, Bloodied Ghost will put a -1/-1 counter on itself, removing the +1/+1 counter.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1479-3257-6662.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3257-6662.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Chocobo Racetrack, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2707-5751-6289-6504.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to draw the land.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

1486-1719-1753-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-1719-1753-5929.description:
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat.
1486-1719-1753-5929.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

573-1479-3908.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
Kodama of the East Tree, Spark Double, and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
Spark Double and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Spark Double token's trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

802-1980-2493-4336-5326.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {U}{B}.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
802-1980-2493-4336-5326.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{B}.
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} and commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Archaeomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Snap to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting The Master.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Snap, targeting Ornithopter.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning Ornithopter to your hand from the battlefield, and untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{B}.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning The Master to your hand from the battlefield, and untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

2723-4163.notablePrerequisites:
Blazing Sunsteel attached to Metropolis Reformer.
You have a way to deal damage to Metropolis Reformer.
You have a way to give Metropolis Reformer indestructible.
2723-4163.description:
Give Metropolis Reformer indestructible, and then deal damage to Metropolis Reformer.
Metropolis Reformer and Blazing Sunsteel trigger.
Resolve the Metropolis Reformer trigger, causing you to gain life equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing that much damage to Metropolis Reformer.
Repeat from step 2.

1601-1636-2577.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional Zombie.
Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
1601-1636-2577.description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
